title: Names used by the typosquat and web-archive modules (batch p1-G01-2: P012, P059)
owner: batch p1-G01-2 (typosquat, typosquat_dnstwister, web_archives, web_archives_deep, web_archives_ukwa)

attributes.lookalike_matches: list of {protected, source, technique, score, lure}: protected domains or brands (org profile, BCB verified domains, suppliers) the entity imitates, from the offline typosquat reverse match
attributes.typosquat_lookalikes: full table of registered lookalike candidates of a brand/domain: {domain, domain_unicode, fuzzer, score, state, ns, a, mx_present, parked, sinkhole, registrar, cnpj_roots, created, age_days, ownership, severity, signals} (HTML/JSON)
attributes.typosquat_top: the 10 highest-ranked registered lookalikes {domain, severity, signals}: what the terminal shows
attributes.typosquat_coverage: typosquat forward-scan coverage: candidates generated/ranked/checked, DoH queries used and budget, cap hits, unregistered, NXDOMAIN not confirmed, could-not-verify and unchecked counts, RDAP lookups
attributes.typosquat_own_registrations: lookalike candidates owned or defensively registered by the organisation (own-asset section, never typosquat findings)
attributes.archive_last: most recent web-archive capture date seen (ISO)
attributes.archive_snapshot: closest archived snapshot {url, captured_at, status, source} on the archive host
attributes.archive_sources: per-archive outcome {source: ok | empty | could_not_verify | rate_limited | blocked | not_run, with the reason}; an empty archive never means a new domain
attributes.archived_urls: historical URLs from web-archive CDX indexes, redacted (URL credentials, tokens, session ids and e-mail addresses masked) and capped; the full list goes to JSON
attributes.homepage_indicators: indicators extracted from the closest archived homepage snapshot {source, snapshot, captured_at, sha256, bytes, truncated, title, lang, analytics_ids, cnpjs, favicon_hrefs, meta_refresh, generator}; the archived body itself is never stored
attributes.archive_estimate: CarbonDate creation-date estimate {estimated_creation, earliest_sources, sources}: an estimate from archives and search engines, never a registration date

relations.lookalike_of: typosquat candidate -> the protected brand domain it imitates (reverse match)
